item.title: Bulletproof Kubernetes Backups: K8up, Self-Hosted REST Server, and Full Prometheus Observability
item.description: Learn how to automate Kubernetes PVC and application backups using K8up, deploy a secure Restic REST backend with a Web UI via Docker, and configure full observability using Prometheus and Grafana.
